Odds & Predictions 2026\",\"url\":\"https://kalshi.com/markets/kxtrumpapprove/trump-approval-rating/kxtrumpapprove-26oct08\"},{\"title\":\"Trump's RCP approval average today? Odds & Predictions 2026\",\"url\":\"https://kalshi.com/markets/kxtrumpapprove/trump-approval-rating/kxtrumpapprove-26oct12\"},{\"title\":\"President Trump Job Approval\",\"url\":\"https://www.realclearpolling.com/polls/approval/donald-trump/approval-rating\"},{\"title\":\"RealClearPolitics - Election Other - President Trump Job Approval\",\"url\":\"https://www.realclearpolitics.com/epolls/other/president_trump_job_approval-6179-test-v2.html\"},{\"title\":\"RealClearPolitics - President Trump Job Approval - Economy\",\"url\":\"https://www.realclearpolitics.com/epolls/other/president_trump_job_approval_economy-6182.html\"},{\"title\":\"Trump Approval Rating 2026 — Monthly Tracker & Historical Comparison\",\"url\":\"https://uspollingdata.com/polls/trump-approval/\"},{\"title\":\"President Trump's approval rating continues to climb\",\"url\":\"https://news.yahoo.com/president-trump-apos-approval-rating-181156523.html\"}]\n\nThe search turned up RCP average readings around 38% in early-to-mid October 2026, though the sources are mixed in quality.\n\n- **RealClearPolling page:** The RCP average shows 38.1% approve and 59.5% disapprove for the 9/21–10/11 window. date: 9/21 - 10/11. The page metadata says it was last updated 59 days ago, so it may not reflect the latest figure.\n- **Kalshi market pages:** These show the RCP average near 38% in recent days. One snapshot for Oct 5 has the average around 38.4–38.5%. Another for Oct 8 has it around 38.3–38.5%. A page labeled \"today\" has it at about 38.0–38.1%. These are market price ranges, not official published values.\n- **Coinbase market:** A market on the Oct 11 RCP average used 37.7% as its threshold. It is marked closed, and the search didn't show the final value.\n- **Wikipedia opinion polling page:** It lists an October 8, 2026 snapshot of several aggregators.
